claim: Delivery pixel size, separate from aspect and from the oversized frame you actually render into. Drop to 832x480 while you are iterating and want turnaround; save 1920x1080 for shots that will be looked at closely, because it costs real time on every retry.
not_visual: A render/delivery setting, not content. Nothing in the prompt moves it — pixel size comes from the SDXL latent dimensions, so panels would differ only in how much detail the sampler had room for, and any clause claiming to express it would be a lie. If an author needs to see it, render the same prompt at each size; that is a resolution test, not a capability card.
